## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat(docker): …`); it becomes the squash commit on `main`
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, or the reason they are not needed is explained above
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, JSON Schema, CHANGELOG for user-facing changes)
- [ ] Architecture changes come with a new or updated ADR in `docs/decisions/`
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private hostnames or personal data in code, logs or fixtures
